artifacts.name: kim2019_spcas9_ht.csv
artifacts.note: Kim et al. 2019 (Science Advances eaax9249) DeepSpCas9 high-throughput SpCas9 on-target dataset: 12,832 synthetic-target guides, 30-mer context in the identical (4+20+3+3) format as Doench-2016 (PAM at positions 24-26), endpoint = background-subtracted indel frequency (%). Extracted (context30, indel_pct) from Supplementary Table S1 via bmds-lab/CRISPR_DeepEnsemble. Used to expand Module V on-target training 2.4x.

note: Real HT SpCas9 on-target efficiency (Kim 2019). Endpoint (indel %) is rank-normalised within-dataset before merging with Doench-2016 drug-rank, so the two comparable-distribution efficiency ranks are pooled for training.
